**Chief Financial Officer (CFO), Priya Nair -** As CFO, Priya owns budgeting, financial planning and risk across Tessera's roughly 210 staff and more than 600 clients. She is analytical and budget-disciplined, with little patience for spend that lacks a defensible business case. TSR-INC-2025-031 has landed about $1.8 million of first-year cost on her books - remediation, client churn (23 clients lost), regulatory engagement and insurance - at the same time as the board's ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification mandate. She is now weighing every security and AI investment against measurable return.

**Interview focus:** Press this person on their own area of responsibility, and on the gap between what the documents claim and what is actually enforced. They will speak to where things are messy, but they will not hand you a conclusion — establishing that is your job.

**How to Chat:**Click the "+" icon in the lower right corner of your screen to open the chat interface. Type your question or message into the text box that appears at the bottom of the chat window. Press the 'Enter' key on your keyboard or click the send button (usually depicted by an arrow) to send your message. The bot will process your message and reply to you directly in the chat window. You can continue to ask questions or request information—just type and send your messages as needed. *Please note that response times may vary, especially during peak usage, as our bot runs on a low-powered GPU.*
